description: Podcast search across the Apple Podcasts directory (iTunes Search API): podcast title, publisher, episode count, genres, latest episode date, explicit flag, RSS feed URL, artwork and Apple Podcasts link, for a search term and optional country store. Related tools on this server, for a different need: media_loom_video_downloader when you need public metadata for a Loom video from Loom's oEmbed API; media_openverse when you need Openverse openly licensed image search: title, creator. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: 2-letter Apple store country, e.g. us, gb, de (default us)
